omega_use_cases.name: screenshot_to_code
omega_use_cases.description: Convert UI screenshots/mockups to Omega Engine stack components (React/Vue/Svelte)

implementation.prompt_template: Generate a {framework} component for Omega Engine matching this screenshot. Use Omega design tokens from config/wads/arcana_nova/ui/tokens. Output complete component with TypeScript types.

omega_use_cases.name: architecture_diagram_to_mermaid
omega_use_cases.description: Convert architecture diagrams (whiteboard photos, Confluence, ASCII) to executable Mermaid/PlantUML

implementation.prompt_template: Convert this architecture diagram to Mermaid format. Preserve all hierarchy, relationships, and labels. Make nodes clickable with hrefs to relevant Omega Engine source files. Output .mmd file content.

omega_use_cases.name: legacy_screenshots_to_docs
omega_use_cases.description: Batch process legacy codebase screenshots (terminal, IDE) into structured markdown documentation

implementation.prompt_template: Analyze this screenshot of legacy code/terminal. Extract: 1) Code structure 2) Key functions/classes 3) Data flow 4) Configuration 5) Issues/TODOs. Output structured markdown for knowledge base ingestion.

omega_use_cases.name: video_tutorials_to_knowledge_base
omega_use_cases.description: Convert Omega workflow video demos (5-10 min) into distilled HALL_OF_RECORDS entries with L1/L2/L3 gnosis

implementation.prompt_template: Watch this video of an Omega Engine workflow. Produce: 1) L1 Narrative: What happened step-by-step 2) L2 Insight: Key patterns, decisions, tradeoffs 3) L3 Universal Principle: Reusable architectural lesson 4) Proposed soul.yaml lesson entry. Format as JSON.
implementation.context_strategy: video_tokens ~1500-50000 depending on length; 1M context handles 10-20 min videos

omega_use_cases.name: visual_regression_testing
omega_use_cases.description: Automated UI screenshot comparison for WAD/stack visual regression detection

implementation.comparison_prompt: Compare these two UI screenshots (baseline vs current). Output JSON: {changed: boolean, regions: [{bbox, change_type, severity, description}], summary: string}. Focus on functional changes, ignore anti-aliasing/timestamp noise.

omega_use_cases.name: entity_relationship_maps
omega_use_cases.description: Convert entity relationship diagrams to YAML definitions + resonance mappings

implementation.prompt_template: Extract entity relationships from this diagram. Output: 1) entities.yaml patch with name, node, traits, capabilities 2) resonance_mappings.yaml updates 3) soul.yaml lesson proposals. Validate against config/glossary.md terminology.
